coastal.title: Simon Fraser University campus receives Indigenous place names in 2 languages
coastal.description: Four First Nations in British Columbia have collaborated with Simon Fraser University to give the school's Burnaby campus place names in two Coast Salish languages.

kamloops.title: Kamloops bridal beauty agency closes amid viral allegations of double-bookings, unpaid debts
kamloops.description: The sudden closure of the Kamloops-based Cassidy Watt Artistry Collective came after dozens of social media posts from clients in early September.

prince-george.title: Gun control advocacy groups push for Tumbler Ridge weapon details
prince-george.description: Five gun control advocacy groups are renewing pressure on the RCMP to disclose information about the firearms used in the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., saying public discussion of the details could help prevent another tragedy.

southeast.title: String of Highway 1 crashes near Revelstoke prompt calls for enforcement, improvements
southeast.description: Leaders and residents from the Revelstoke region are calling for improvements to a section of the Trans Canada Highway, following a string of fatal collisions and prolonged closures.
